categories.main_business_segments: Orbbec Inc. primarily operates in the design, research, development, production, and sales of 3D visual perception products. Its main product categories include 3D vision sensors, consumer-grade application devices, and industrial-grade application devices. The company serves markets such as AIoT (Artificial Intelligence of Things), biometric recognition, 3D scanning, industrial 3D measurement, and robotics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed a comprehensive 3D visual perception technology system covering multiple mainstream technologies including structured light, indirect Time-of-Flight (iToF), direct Time-of-Flight (dToF), binocular vision, and Lidar. It possesses full-stack R&D capabilities encompassing system design, chip design, algorithm development, optical system design, software development, and mass production technology. Orbbec also designs proprietary chips such as depth engine chips and specialized photosensitive chips, and has established advanced manufacturing processes enabling million-level production scale.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Orbbec serves a diverse customer base including leading enterprises in robotics (service, industrial, humanoid), AIoT devices, biometric payment terminals, 3D scanning for industrial design and cultural heritage, and industrial 3D measurement sectors. Key markets include AI-enabled robotics, offline facial recognition payment, medical insurance verification, 3D printing, AR/VR, and industrial automation. The company has established stable partnerships with top-tier customers domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Guangdong. It has established overseas subsidiaries and sales platforms in the United States, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Europe, actively expanding its presence in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific markets. Overseas business includes collaborations with international partners in robotics, AI, and 3D scanning applications.
categories.supply_chain_position: Orbbec operates across the 3D visual perception industry supply chain, including upstream sensor module manufacturing, midstream 3D vision solution development, and downstream application algorithm integration. It adopts a fabless model for chip production, outsourcing wafer fabrication while maintaining in-house design and assembly. The company also produces consumer and industrial application devices, positioning itself as an integrated solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing 3D visual perception technologies through continuous innovation and full-stack R&D. Key R&D initiatives include developing next-generation depth engine chips, enhancing multi-modal AI vision perception, and expanding applications in robotics and AIoT. Orbbec emphasizes building a 'robotics and AI vision industrial platform' to support intelligent terminals in understanding the 3D world, with ongoing projects in autonomous mobile robot solutions, high-performance Lidar, and SDK/application algorithm development.
categories.revenue_model: Orbbec generates revenue primarily through direct sales of 3D vision sensors, consumer-grade and industrial-grade application devices. The company employs a direct sales model domestically and internationally. Revenue streams also include licensing of technology, provision of technical services, and sales of software development kits (SDKs) and application algorithms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Orbbec is one of the few global companies with comprehensive proprietary 3D visual perception technology and mass production capability, competing with industry leaders such as Apple, Microsoft, Sony, Intel, Huawei, and Samsung. It holds a strong position in the Chinese market and is recognized internationally for its technological innovation and product quality. The company benefits from high entry barriers in the 3D vision sensor industry due to technical complexity and capital requirements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Orbbec achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 564.46 million, representing a 56.79% year-over-year increase. Despite continued losses, net loss attributable to shareholders narrowed by 77.20% to RMB -62.91 million. The company is in a rapid growth phase, investing heavily in R&D (36.20% of revenue) and production capacity expansion, with total assets around RMB 3.33 billion and net assets near RMB 2.87 billion as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Orbbec emphasizes its full-stack, multi-technology 3D visual perception capabilities, delivering high-precision, cost-effective, and reliable 3D vision sensors and solutions. Its proprietary chip designs, advanced optical systems, and integrated software algorithms provide differentiated performance in complex environments. The company’s products enable intelligent terminals to 'understand the world' in 3D, supporting diverse applications from robotics to biometric payment and industrial measurement, thereby offering customers comprehensive, scalable, and innovative 3D vision solutions.
